TEXT:
With the explanation session coming to an end, we 
headed for the clubroom again.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Showing up right after I texted you, well aren't 
you brimming with energy?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh? A text...

Ah, she's right. There's a text message notification 
on my phone.

"We'll have a meeting for the production of a new 
game, in preparation for the upcoming Cultural 
Festival, so please gather at the clubroom" ...Huh.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Actually, I only just read the text. Today was just 
pure coincidence...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Ehhh? Really!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Geez. Please give your club activities some thought. 
I know it's the long-awaited summer holidays, you 
want to be lovey-dovey with Onii-chan, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
As if. I've been studying for my exams, so I can't 
show up as much!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Studying alone with Onii-chan, I'll bet?

Don't stare at me with those eyes full of hope. 
They're dazzling, but deep inside is rotten beyond 
belief.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Behind closed doors, teaching each other every 
detail, whatever could you two be studying, Senpai, 
you dog! Fuhihihihi!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Enough with that creepy laugh, seriously...

It might seem unbelievable, but in her brain lies an 
image of Kouhei and I being lovers.

She's the so-called "Fujoshi", but coupling your 
own brother and your club's senior together, that's 
not normal.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, is everyone else coming back today?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Club President and Makabe-senpai are already in 
the clubroom. I sent Gokou-san a text already, so 
she'll be arriving soon.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Is that right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Club Pres and Makabe-Senpai... They keep hanging 
out in the clubroom, even though it's the summer 
holidays. Don't you think they're a little too close?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Oh my, is it because their affection is way too 
deep, or that the high school boy's sexual desires 
are scary, or-

...What's this girl going on about, acting all proud? 
The scary one is your brain.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
That aside, a new game, huh. I don't think there's 
much I can really do to help out.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I believe you have the talent to manage a project. 
I'm hoping you can do something along those lines.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Managing a project? You mean stuff like... preparing 
a schedule?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Yes. As it is now, everyone in the club is eccentric 
and works without stopping, so we're helpless 
without someone to manage it all.
You're at the top of that list of eccentrics.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Aren't you better at management, compared to 
me?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I want to focus on the game contents this time. 
That's why I'm counting on you to manage this 
project well♪
Feels like an unpleasant chore instead.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Stuff like allocating tasks, deciding "What game 
should we make", making decisions after our club 
discussion. That's our objective today.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
...You're putting a lot of responsibility on someone 
who rarely shows up for club.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Oh you. I have faith that you'll be able to handle 
this well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey now, don't expect too much.

We continued talking while walking down the hall, 
just when we were about to enter-
Sena's cellphone went off.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
...I wonder who it is, maybe Onii-chan? Lately, he's 
been sending a text every hour.

Akagi's already that much of a siscon. It's as if 
they're a couple in a new relationship.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Hm? What's up? Is it a harassing text from Akagi?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
No, it isn't Onii-chan... it's Gokou-san. She's taking care 
of her sister and can't make it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's too bad.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
*sigh* With Gokou-san gone, there's no point in 
splitting up the tasks. To begin with, the club's 
games were practically all done by both of us...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Come on, don't say that. The president's here, isn't 
he? Even he can make games, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
The games he makes reveals his mischievous 
nature well, extremely challenging shooting games 
that only he can appreciate.

That's pretty harsh... Well, what she said of the 
president's games is accurate, so I can't defend 
him in any way, but still...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I-In any case, let's just have a discussion with 
whoever that's here. Okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sorry for being late.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [font_size=33]Wait... There's no one here![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
That's not possible, those two should be waiting in 
here...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: ...They're gone.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hey, look at this.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: They left... a letter?

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Yo, you guys! We were having a stupid discussion, 
then suddenly an incredible urge to visit the beach 
overcame us, so we headed off to check things out.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Senachi will take my place and handle the rest. Best 
regards!

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
P.S. If we end up taking photos of girls in swimsuits, 
we'll share it with you so rest assured, Kousaka~

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
...Those damn otaku...! They're practically shut-ins, yet 
now they're acting as if they're youthful teens...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: A-ahahahaha... ahaha... ha...

No wonder she's fuming! She made such an honest 
effort to organize a meeting, yet no one is here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So... What now?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
"What now" you ask? We can't get anything done 
with just the two of us! We're postponing this 
meeting!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
How dare those two just...! Skipping club activities, 
going to the beach...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Seriously, just how close are those two... Guys and 
their swimming trunks? They're practically naked...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
And in those trunks, the club president making out 
with Makabe-senpai... fufufu, ufufufufu...①

Great, Sena's immersed in her rotten delusions 
again...
